title: Post-hoc per-class transfer and paired significance analysis of archived DCTPR development predictions
purpose: Report class-level positive/negative transfer, worst-class harm, and paired significance for the accuracy gaps already reported in the manuscript. Required by project discipline rule 9 (report class-level transfer and worst class, not only overall balanced accuracy).

inputs.official_test: NOT_USED. Per-query official-test predictions were never archived locally; PAT-K-260805-009 stores aggregate and per-rotation metrics only. This analysis is development-episode only.

what_is_forbidden: any new inference, retuning, or method variant
selecting which classes to report after seeing the significance outcome
converting a non-significant gap into a claim of parity

preregistered_quantities.per_class_accuracy: for each dataset, class, and method: mean over 3 episodes x 10 support rotations of the 9 per-class query decisions
preregistered_quantities.transfer_label: class is positive transfer if DCTPR per-class accuracy exceeds BL-NCC, negative if below, neutral if equal
preregistered_quantities.worst_class_harm: most negative per-class DCTPR minus BL-NCC delta, in percentage points
preregistered_quantities.paired_test: two-sided exact McNemar on discordant query decisions, computed within a single rotation where the 1800 (CUB) / 1080 (Dogs) query images are distinct, then reported per rotation and as a count of rotations reaching alpha=0.05
preregistered_quantities.error_overlap: Jaccard overlap of error sets and joint-error fraction between DCTPR and the strongest matched solver

statistical_caveats: Support rotations reuse the same episode images and are not independent replicates; rotation-level McNemar results are reported individually and are not pooled into a single p-value.
Episodes within a dataset share the same class set, so per-class means average over correlated rotations.
McNemar tests the paired decision difference on one rotation's distinct query images only; it does not test the cross-episode mean gap.
